purpose: Official issuer records for the test-window distribution audit (Stage 2 gate 5 criteria, unchanged)
method: Read in the built-in browser on the project lead's computer (issuer sites are not reachable from the backtest environment). Each full issuer file's SHA-256 was computed in the browser on the bytes as served; rows were extracted in the page (iShares SpreadsheetML parsed by pattern; State Street .xlsx unzipped with the browser's deflate decoder), filtered to the audit window, and each capture's SHA-256 computed in the browser before transcription. Nothing was saved on the computer.
